notes: Both interrogative particles take the ASV's fronted auxiliaries ('Art', 'hast') under rule 17, leaving each verb its subject pronoun and lexical verb; the citation of rule 50 beside rule 17 on הִקְהַלְתָּ is inessential, as rule 17 alone decides it.
The waw before כָל־כְּפִרֶיהָ is rendered 'with', which rule 14 lists explicitly among the connectives a waw may take; five waws answer five written connectives.
The head of 'the young lions' is on 'lions' with 'young' as specifier, and the unit's note records the competing reading.
